local.h: How to serve a safe Thanksgiving meal
local.b: Food poisoning outbreaks tend to rise in November and December, the CDC says, with tainted turkey, undercooked stuffing and holiday buffets behind past illnesses. Here's how to avoid them.
local.title: What to do to have a safe Thanksgiving meal

local.h: Delta system glitch delays flights at Atlanta airport
local.b: An issue with Delta's weight and balance system at Hartsfield-Jackson is delaying thousands of flights ahead of Thanksgiving, the FAA said.
local.title: Delta delays flights ahead of Thanksgiving holiday over system failure

local.h: Coastal storm set to soak Thanksgiving
local.b: Tuesday and Wednesday look clear for travel, but a coastal storm is expected to bring soaking rain, strong wind gusts and coastal flooding on Thanksgiving Day.
local.title: Thanksgiving travel forecast: Quiet week before an impactful Thanksgiving storm

local.h: ICE keeps making courthouse arrests despite new state law
local.b: Immigration agents are still arresting people at Massachusetts courthouses, including a Framingham district court, despite the state's new PROTECT Act.

goodnews.b: Kids skated in the Joseph Lee K-8 School auditorium Friday night at an annual community event where families also picked up Thanksgiving food.
goodnews.title: Annual turkey giveaway centers community, roller skating in Dorchester

goodnews.h: ProBlak's mural brings community stories to A.R.T.'s new center
goodnews.b: Artist Rob "ProBlak" Gibbs has created a massive mural for the American Repertory Theater's new Goel Center in Allston, which opens to the public in April 2027.
goodnews.title: ProBlak’s huge mural brings community stories to A.R.T.’s new center

local.h: Chicago bets on the Soul Train Awards to boost tourism
local.b: Taped in Chicago, the Soul Train Awards return to network TV Friday after a two-year hiatus, and local officials hope the show will draw tourism and more awards specials to the city.
local.title: Can the Soul Train Awards help boost Chicago’s reputation as an entertainment destination?

local.h: Ankle monitors take over a Chicagoan's life
local.b: As the administration puts ankle monitors on more immigrants, advocates say they aren't necessary for people complying with their cases and take a toll on mental health.
local.title: As the Trump administration puts ankle monitors on more immigrants, it’s taking over this Chicagoan’s life

local.h: Teen critically wounded in Riverdale shooting
local.b: An 18-year-old was shot in the head Saturday night after a group of men approached him in the 800 block of East 130th Place, police said. He was taken to UChicago Medical Center in critical condition.
local.title: Teen critically wounded in Riverdale shooting

local.h: Flu cases surge ahead of Thanksgiving
local.b: More than 43,000 New Yorkers have caught the flu since early October, compared with about 7,000 at this point last season, state data shows.
local.title: Reported flu cases surge across New York ahead of Thanksgiving

local.h: NY sues HUD over mixed-status housing rule
local.b: The state and city sued over a federal rule that could strip housing assistance from about 20,000 families in which not every member is a citizen or eligible non-citizen.
local.title: NYC, state sue Trump administration over ‘mixed-status’ federal housing assistance rule

local.h: Top court upholds Section 8 renter protection
local.b: New York's Court of Appeals upheld a state law banning discrimination against tenants who pay rent with housing subsidies, siding with Attorney General Letitia James against an Ithaca landlord.
local.title: New York’s highest court upholds key protection for low-income renters with Section 8

local.h: New film captures ICE agents' banter at NYC courthouse arrests
local.b: Journalist Emma V.F. filmed scores of arrests at 26 Federal Plaza, along with the rarely seen small talk among the ICE agents making them.
local.title: New film captures ICE agents' banter amid NYC courthouse arrests

local.h: Citi Bike e-bike rides to be capped at $3.65 for members
local.b: Under a new deal between Mayor Zohran Mamdani's administration and Lyft, Citi Bike members will pay no more than $3.65 for e-bike rides up to 45 minutes starting Jan. 19, 2027.
local.title: NYC Citi Bike member rides to be capped at $3.65 after Mamdani inks new deal with Lyft

local.h: Abandoned dog family found in the cold in Orange, NJ
local.b: Animal protection officers found two dogs tied to a fence in Orange, just west of Newark, along with five newborn puppies. One puppy died, the Associated Humane Societies said.
local.title: 1 puppy dead, another fighting for its life after dog family abandoned in NJ cold

local.h: Aber Kawas becomes first Palestinian in New York state Senate
local.b: Aber Kawas won election as the first Palestinian in New York Senate history, celebrating with hundreds of Democratic Socialists of America members on election night.

local.h: Jersey City rent control push ends in setback for DSA members
local.b: A bill from progressive Jersey City council members to protect tenants of a waterfront high-rise from rent hikes was tossed before it could be formally introduced.
local.title: A rush to rent control in Jersey City ends in a setback for DSA council members

goodnews.h: About 100 New Yorkers ditched their smartphones for a month
goodnews.b: A phone-free party celebrated roughly 100 New Yorkers who gave up their smartphones for a month, with a showcase of the hobbies and art projects they picked up instead.
goodnews.title: These New Yorkers ditched their smartphones for a month. No, seriously.

goodnews.h: Adopt a storm drain? Council bill would enlist New Yorkers
goodnews.b: A City Council bill would let residents volunteer to clear leaves and litter from storm drains on their block, building on a pilot in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, to help prevent flooding.
goodnews.title: Adopt a storm drain? NYC proposal aims to enlist residents in flood prevention.

local.h: Three detained over Normandy train derailment
local.b: French police arrested three people in connection with the September derailment between Rouen and Caen that injured 44 people, sources said.
local.title: France detains three over mystery train derailment

local.h: Where the presidential candidates stand on rural France
local.b: Rural France, home to a third of the population, is a key 2027 battleground, with residents more reliant on cars and facing reduced public services such as healthcare. A look at the candidates' policies.
local.title: Compared: The presidential candidates' policies for rural France

local.h: Activists demand tear gas suspension over reported health effects
local.b: French activists and lawmakers want police to stop using tear gas after women reported menstrual changes following protests. An advocacy group says it has over 10,000 complaints; scientists have not confirmed a link.

local.h: Le Pen denies receiving secrets from civil servant
local.b: Marine Le Pen denied receiving confidential information from a civil servant suspected of leaking investigation details to her National Rally party, but said she could not say whether others in the party had.

local.h: Budget talks and Black Friday top France's week ahead
local.b: Lawmakers meet in committee to try to strike a deal on the social security budget, a trial opens for seven men accused of raising funds for the PKK, and retailers gear up for Black Friday.

local.h: France sees sixth straight weekend of cost-of-living protests
local.b: Tens of thousands marched in French cities on Saturday demanding better public services and protesting rising prices and inequality, though turnout has dwindled.

local.h: Dallesport residents fight huge data center plan
local.b: Neighbors in rural Klickitat County are organizing against a proposed hyperscale data center campus that could one day reach one gigawatt.
local.title: Rural Washington community organizes against massive data center proposal

local.h: Longest-serving state justice to retire
local.b: Washington Supreme Court Justice Charles W. Johnson, on the court for 36 years, will leave when his term ends this year at the state's mandatory age limit of 75.
local.title: Record tenure concludes as Charles Johnson retires from Washington state Supreme Court

local.h: Seattle lab aims to break down 'forever chemicals'
local.b: Nature has no tools to break down PFAS, the so-called forever chemicals invented in the 1930s. A Seattle protein design lab is trying to build some.

local.h: Father and daughter held by ICE at Sea-Tac were headed to a baptism
local.b: The father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on a Sea-Tac jet bridge Saturday were traveling to a family baptism in California, their lawyer said. Passenger videos of the arrest were widely viewed.

local.h: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7
local.b: Open enrollment is underway for Medicare, which covers roughly 70 million people, and coverage choices for 2027 are complex and often consequential. The season ends Dec. 7.
